title: Linear Feature-Dimension Sweep
prompt:
Implement `double_descent_sweep(n_train, n_test, dimensions, noise_std=0.1, seed=0)`. Generate one Gaussian linear-data realization, then evaluate the requested feature dimensions in their supplied order. For width `p`, use the first `p` columns from that same generated data and fit the minimum-norm least-squares solution. Return a list of `(p, train_mse, test_mse)` tuples. Widths may exceed the number of training examples, so use a stable least-squares or pseudoinverse method.

The exercise measures a sweep; it must not claim that every finite random seed produces a visually dramatic double-descent curve.

example.output: three finite train/test MSE records in the requested order
example.reasoning: All widths evaluate nested views of one fixed data draw.
